evidence_items.locator: Abstract, findings from repeated OSWorld executions
evidence_items.explanation: The April evaluation reports that repeated execution can change task outcomes despite an unchanged task and model. This supports practical unpredictability in the agent workflows discussed in the post.
Repeated outputs varied in consequential details while retaining substantial semantic consistency. This supports a limited claim of unreliable exact outcomes, rather than complete randomness.

This controlled demonstration is material counterevidence to a literal assertion that LLM inference can never be deterministic. It does not establish generally correct or successful task execution and predates the target window.
